```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(ggplot2)

library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)

library(pheatmap)

library(bbknnR)
library(harmony)

source("../../Utils/combine_Seurat_ds.R")
source("../../Utils/downsample_seurat.R")

library(future)
plan("multicore", workers = 10)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 10*2**32)

data_storage_folder = "../../../Data/ExtData/Yue_scRNA_IMO"
if (!file.exists(data_storage_folder)) dir.create(data_storage_folder, recursive=T)
```

```{r}
reload_data = T
if(reload_data) {
  load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "All_Filtered_scData.Rdata"))
  meta <- readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Yue_IMO_metadata.rds"))
  all_ge_data_filtered@meta.data <- meta[match(Cells(all_ge_data_filtered), rownames(meta)),]
  
  all_ge_data_filtered@meta.data$orig_sample_id = all_ge_data_filtered$orig.ident
  all_ge_data_filtered@meta.data$DS = "Yue_IMO"
}
```


```{r}
if(reload_data) {
  sc_gut = LoadH5Seurat("../../../Data/ExtData/GCA/epi_raw_counts02_healthy_adult_intestine.h5seurat")

  sc_gut@meta.data$orig.ident = sc_gut$Sample.name
  sel_samples = as.character(unique(sc_gut$orig.ident))
  # The excluded sample (A33 414C) has way more cells than the other ones, with many clusters after CCA being exclusively from this sample; some with signs of contamination (CD45+, CD69+,MZB1+ subcluster)
  sel_samples = sel_samples[!sel_samples == "A33 (414C)"]
  sc_gut@meta.data <- droplevels(sc_gut@meta.data)
  sc_gut = subset(sc_gut, orig.ident %in% sel_samples)
  sc_gut@meta.data$Condition <- sc_gut$Region
  sc_gut@meta.data$cluster_label <- sc_gut$annotation
  sc_gut@meta.data$DS <- "GCA"
}
```

```{r}
combined_sc_data <- combine_2_ds(all_ge_data_filtered, sc_gut, shared_features_only = T)
LayerData <- function(obj, assay="RNA", layer="counts") { slot(slot(combined_sc_data, "assays")[[assay]], layer) }
combined_sc_data <- downsample_to_median_read_count(combined_sc_data, target_median_lib_size = 5000, min_detected_cells = 3)

```

```{r}
# score cell cycle aross the whole data set, then determine variable features from integrated data, excluding any nown cell cycle genes.
set.seed(20230808)

cell_cycle_genes1 = read.table("../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/Proliferation_associated_genes_Schwede_et_al_2013.txt", sep="\t", header = T)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
cc_genes1 = select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=cell_cycle_genes1$ENSGENEID, keytype = "ENSEMBL", columns="SYMBOL")

var_features = SelectIntegrationFeatures(sc.list)
var_features = var_features[!var_features %in% cc_genes1$SYMBOL]

scData.combined <- merge(sc.list[[1]], sc.list[2:length(sc.list)])
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

all.genes <- rownames(scData.combined)
scData.combined <- CellCycleScoring(scData.combined, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes, g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes)
scData.combined <- ScaleData(scData.combined, verbose = TRUE, features = var_features, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score","G2M.Score"))
scData.combined <- RunPCA(scData.combined, npcs = 30, verbose = TRUE, features = var_features)
scData.combined <- RunBBKNN(scData.combined, reduction = "pca", batch_key = "orig.ident", n_pcs = 30, run_TSNE = F)
scData.combined <- FindClusters(scData.combined, resolution = 0.9, graph.name = "bbknn")
```

# Global clusters

```{r, fig.width=14}
DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", raster=T)

p1 <- DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "DS", raster=T)
p2 <- DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, raster=T)
plot_grid(p1, p2)

DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", split.by = "DS", label = T, raster=T)
DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", split.by = "Condition", label = T, raster=T, ncol=6)

DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cluster_label", label = T, raster=T)

DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cluster_label", split.by="DS", label = T, raster=T)
```

## Cluster assignments

```{r}
m = table(scData.combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters, ifelse(scData.combined$DS == "GCA", scData.combined@meta.data$orig.ident, scData.combined$sample_label) )
kable(m)
```


```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
mm = as.matrix.data.frame(m)
colnames(mm) = colnames(m)
rownames(mm) = rownames(m)
mm_rel = sweep(mm, 2, apply(mm, 2,sum), "/")
pheatmap(mm_rel, main="Relative single cell contribution of each cluster to condition totals")
```
